Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::createLoanAccount(loanaccountid:Integer,balance:Real,status:LoanAccountStatus[NORMAL|HASPAIDINFULL]): Boolean {
          definition:
          la:LoanAccount = LoanAccount.allInstance()->any(o | o.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid)
            
            precondition:
          la.oclIsUndefined() = true or LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(la)
            
            postcondition:
          LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(la) and la.oclIsUndefined() = false or let laNew:LoanAccount in laNew.oclIsNew() and LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(laNew) and laNew.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid and laNew.Balance = balance and laNew.Status = status and result = true
            
        }
